Mantri indradatt kekaiy naresh ko vishnugupt dvara die gae upayon ko samjhata hai magar kekaiy naresh ko lagta hai ki kahin unke sath kuchh galat to nahin kiya ja raha. kya indradatt unhen samjha pane men saphal ho paenge dekhie is kari men
Minister Indradutt explains to Kekayya King the measures given by Vishnugupta but Kekayya King feels that something wrong is being done to him. Will Indradutt be successful in convincing them? Watch this episode.
Episode 21 Part -1 of a 47-part historical drama Chanakya. An epic Indian television series.
Written and directed by Dr. Chandraprakash Dwivedi.
